water_height_method: Nearest source submerged vertex; disconnected raised pools retain their original level instead of sharing the river plane
water_extension_rule: Only connected underwater cells within 12.8m of source enabled cells; source cells retained
shoreline_method: 2.4m low-pass relief with 0.6–2.4m contour warp within 18m of shore; source wet points and adjacent walk grades constrained
